funding.value: Paid assistantships are limited in number.

entry_route.value: Applicants can enter with a bachelor's or a master's in mechanical, manufacturing or industrial engineering.
entry_route.quote: Baccalaureate degree in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or a closely related discipline from a regionally accredited university | Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, or a closely related discipline, from an accredited college or university
